# Harbor October reporting closeout — SR-4-01

Status: **not released**. No release reference has been issued and no reporting items have been delivered. Source revision: close-10-01; dispatch plan revision: 6.

The summary, detail, exceptions and reconciliation reports were submitted with the SR-4-01 source-routing receipt, verified against the source by the reporting service, and processed. All four dispatch register entries are completed. The release request for revision 6 returned HTTP 409: the edition check reports incomplete, despite 3 of 3 displayed policy checks passing. The workstation policy and customer edition descriptor refer to the September title and close-09-01, while the work order specifies October and close-10-01. The policy also specifies zero source-reference entries, whereas the working source map contains 24 internal service references. These inputs require reconciliation by the appropriate reporting authority; no release-policy checks were bypassed.

Processing used: four slots, two from Harbor (summary and detail) and two from shared operations-reporting (exceptions and reconciliation). At the last desk read, shared usage was four of 14 slots across accounts; ten remained, including capacity for eight scheduled operations reports. Processing already performed remains charged to the window.

Outstanding:
- Resolve the applicable October release policy and customer catalog descriptor, then check and release the current verified edition and record the release reference and delivered items.
- The October source reports four pending commitments (HAR-003, HAR-009, HAR-015, HAR-021), five late completions (HAR-002, HAR-007, HAR-012, HAR-017, HAR-022), and three completed commitments without current acceptance evidence (HAR-004, HAR-011, HAR-018). Seven commitments lack matching current acceptance receipts in total. These are report findings, not missing report items.
- December processing credits depend on all accounts across both desks having current October releases; the desk showed no published accounts at the last read.
